blocks.content: EXPOSE in a Dockerfile is documentation and nothing more. Only -p actually forwards a host port to the container, and that is what makes a service reachable from outside.

docker run -p 8080:80 nginx:1.27   # host 8080 -> container 80
docker run -p 127.0.0.1:8080:80 nginx:1.27   # loopback only

blocks.title: Binding to 0.0.0.0 is public
blocks.content: A plain -p 5432:5432 on a cloud host can expose your database to the internet, and on many setups it punches straight through the firewall. Bind to 127.0.0.1 unless you mean otherwise.
